WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, c.district_id AS client_district_id, d.A3 AS region,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count
  FROM disp AS o
  JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = o.client_id
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE o.type = 'OWNER'
  GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(client_count) AS total_clients
  FROM district_counts
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT dc.region,
       AVG(dc.client_count) AS average_district_client_count,
       AVG(1.0 * dc.client_count / rt.total_clients) AS average_district_share
FROM district_counts AS dc
JOIN region_totals AS rt ON rt.region = dc.region
GROUP BY dc.region
